basicInfo.name: Raffael Eloi
basicInfo.title: Software Engineer | Software Architect
basicInfo.summary: I’m a Software Engineer with a strong focus on backend development and software architecture, while also having solid experience delivering end-to-end solutions across the frontend and backend. My work centers on building, maintaining, and evolving scalable backend systems using C# and .NET, with a strong emphasis on clean code, SOLID principles, and long-term maintainability.

experience.description: Building and maintaining seamless integrations between HungerRush’s core platform and third-party services. Designing and maintaining backend services using C# and .NET on Azure Container Apps.
details: Architected scalable backend services using .NET 8 and Azure Container Apps.
Integrated third-party delivery platforms reducing order failures by 15%.
Implemented improved logging and monitoring solutions using Azure Application Insights.

experience.description: Contributing to client projects like Mastrius and HungerRush. Working across backend and frontend systems, refactoring code, and ensuring continuous platform evolution.
details: Refactored legacy codebases to modern .NET standards, improving maintainability.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver features on tight deadlines.
Provided technical guidance and code reviews for junior team members.

experience.description: Designed a microservices architecture using .NET 9. Built three Vue 3 frontend applications. Established engineering processes in Azure DevOps.
details: Designing a robust Microservices Architecture using .NET 9.
Building three frontend applications using Vue 3 and TypeScript.
Establishing Engineering Processes and CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.

Tenant automation using Python scripts to streamline onboarding.
